decision: Copy parallelism improves the full GPU transition but GPU still loses to native serial and 10-worker pool at all measured batches. Builders remain the next measured target. All production defaults remain reference.

effects_subprofile.aggregation: Median over 12 captures per batch; categories are summed within each capture before aggregation; inclusive child spans must not be added to their parents.
effects_subprofile.editor: Reference context default in frozen profile helper45c5de8; no editor override.
effects_subprofile.instrumentation: Explicit context-scoped wrappers only; no production apply/menu reimplementation or default fences. Existing return objects retained until outside-timer checks, extending allocation lifetimes.
layout_proof: Exact tensor dtype/device/shape/stride/storage offset/layout/grad flag and every returned value
All dataclass fields, mappings and sequence metadata
Every retained intermediate and final complete native State/history/RNG/keys
Source records/string pool/usage/sections/errors and immutable static context unchanged
effects_subprofile.proof_count_scope: Byte/tensor counts include repeated/shared substructures across span return proofs; they are verification counts, not unique state sizes.

limits: Effects profile is intrusive and cannot be substituted for full-step throughput.
No full-game, MCTS, training or playing-strength claim.
Fixed controlled-minor fixtures are not a campaign-position distribution.
Repeated immutable expected-source checks do not measure chronological-game cache hit rate or free identity generation.
Parallel source-tree validation/builders are later unmeasured work, not included in these copy-only numbers.

matched_complete_step.aggregation: Median over 12 unfenced samples per batch/editor, four families×three repetitions. Separately fenced stage medians use four profiles per batch/editor.
matched_complete_step.native_timer_exclusions: Owner/wrapper locks, GIL, input trial clones, full-output capture/verification, Python boxing and pool startup
matched_complete_step.native_timer_scope: Warm cached Engine key guard, original Engine.resolveChance (including its internal clone/validation/history/RNG), output Engine key; native pool dispatch included
matched_complete_step.only_selected_difference: DeviceStateContext editor_implementation reference versus parallel; unit formatter, unrolled SHA, default digest groups and certified source reuse identical.
